title: Special inspection.
officialText:
The installation of on-site stormwater disposal systems shall be subject to special inspection in
accordance with Section 1704.21 of the New York City Building Code. Minor variations, based on actual site conditions, shall be
acceptable at the discretion of the registered design professional of record.
